newsitem.title: GERMANY: Thyssen plans capital raise up to 150 mln.
newsitem.headline: Thyssen plans capital raise up to 150 mln.

text.p: German industrial conglomerate Thyssen AG said on Thursday that it is planning a capital raise of up to 150 million marks in the autumn of 1997.
Further details of amount of the capital raise would be given once preparations, based on market conditions, have been concluded, the group said in a compulsory statement.
The statement came after Thyssen's supervisory board approved the move at a meeting.
The new shares will be offered both in Germany and abroad and the issue will be managed by a consortium led by Commerzbank AG.

The bookbuilding period is planned for the first two weeks in September. The capital raised from the issue will be used to fund the expansion of strategically important and profitable business areas, Thyssen said.
Thyssen shares ended bourse trade in Frankfurt at 433.50 marks, down 8.50 marks.
